sourceInventory.generatedDeepAssessment: Static inspection finds 16 literal Education deep records and no Education generator. Root runtime inventory confirms 16 deep IDs, exactly matching this source inventory; generators for other stations are outside the Education count.

runtimeConfirmation.executedBy: root coordinating agent, not the documentation subagent

specDrift.questionnaireCountNote: The spec old total99 implies 48 questionnaire items; the actual 103 inventory has 52. The spec phrase other 46 pack plus 2 deep is historical.

mappingLimits.limit: Exact teacher approval tests one grade write only. EDU-K12-13 also asks for lifecycle risk management, dataset governance, logs and technical documentation; education-deep-02 also requires cohort accuracy and override evidence. Those remain unsupported by that fixture.

The proposed capability gate addresses emotion inference under Art. 5(1)(f). It does not test exploitation of age or disability vulnerabilities under Art. 5(1)(b), the wider prohibited-practice screen or approved medical/safety exceptions.

This is a proposed boundary wrapper for the P2-27 two-institution fixture, which is absent. It must give not_evaluated without that dependency. It does not establish an actual FERPA exception, emergency threat rationale, de-identification result, studies agreement, school direct-control contract, redisclosure rule or IDEA access record.

Automated WCAG 2.1 A/AA checks of one synthetic HTML lesson cover only automatable checks. Interfaces, mobile apps, contracted material, diverse learning modalities, assistive-technology testing, legal scope and entity deadlines require separate evidence and manual assessment.
An HTML checker does not test ETSI EN 301 549 assistive-technology interoperability or diverse physical input/output modalities.
These actual questions concern WCAG 2.2 added criteria and accessible authentication. A WCAG 2.1 checker does not establish their coverage; leave the additional 2.2 checks and manual assessment open.

These actual questions concern Revised Section 508, including WCAG 2.0 and software/electronic-content requirements and an accessibility conformance report. A WCAG 2.1 automated HTML result is partial evidence only.
An automated output check does not publish the accessibility statement or implement the feedback/request mechanism asked by this actual question.
Contrast checks may give a local HTML observation; release-wide contrast coverage, remediation and audit records remain separate duties.

The available experimental, unreviewed COPPA draft addresses separate third-party-disclosure consent. The actual questions ask consent before collection, use or disclosure, and EDU-K12-1 also asks renewed consent after material changes. The draft covers neither those broader obligations nor a production consent adapter; Education-specific applicability and evaluated reuse remain pending.
